newsitem.title: ITALY: Agip starts output at new Nile gas field.
newsitem.headline: Agip starts output at new Nile gas field.

text.p: Italy's Agip, through its affiliate the International Egyption Oil Company (IEOC), has started up production at a new gas field at Darfeel off the Nile delta, its parent ENI said in a statement.
IEOC intends to exploit the Darfeel field in two phases, with the initial installation of a well followed by the installation of an offshore platform which will link five other wells.
The well is currently producing 500,000 cubic metres per day but the field is forecast to produce up to 5.2 million cubic metres of gas per day.
Over the last 14 months, Darfeel is the fifth IEOC gas field successfully put into production in the area after those of Port Fouad, Nidoco, Wakar and Baltim South.
The Port Fouad, Wakar and Darfeel fields are part of Agip's North Port Said concession where an intense drilling campaign is being carried out.
